title: Integration verification: auth flows end-to-end
acceptance_criteria: rails db:migrate creates users table without errors
Sign up: create new user at /users/sign_up → redirected to root
Sign in: login at /users/sign_in → redirected to root
Sign out: logout → redirected to sign_in
Non-admin user has admin: false, admin user has admin: true
rails server boots cleanly with Devise routes
